archiveTitle: Daily Brief | STRANGER THAN HEAVEN Confirms Digital Roles for Bunta Sugawara and Tupac

entries.headline: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – The Viking Sagas Is Available Now
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announced that Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – The Viking Sagas is available now. The immutable packet provides only the official launch headline, so no platform, pricing, or content details are added.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire page confirms only the title and “Available Now”; no details beyond the official headline were inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published on Xbox Wire at 2:00 AM Beijing time on September 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant Details Melee Combat, Region Progression, and a Non-Linear Manhattan
entries.summary: Remedy outlined CONTROL Resonant’s systems on Xbox Wire. Dylan Faden’s melee-focused progression spans a large Talent tree, weapon forms, secondary weapons, combat abilities, and combo finishers. Manhattan is divided into dense, non-linear zones that level up through combat, secrets, and quests, while defeating Resonant Entities makes those areas more dangerous.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire first-party article supports the gameplay, progression, and world-structure details; promotional judgments were not recast as independent facts.
entries.timeNote: Published at 9:00 PM Beijing time on September 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN Confirms Digital Roles for Bunta Sugawara and Tupac
entries.summary: SEGA revealed key cast details for STRANGER THAN HEAVEN. Bunta Sugawara was recreated with his family’s consent and materials from Toei, while Tupac portrays Amaru under ongoing supervision from Amaru Entertainment, without the use of AI. The 50-year story runs from 1915 to 1965 across five cities and launches January 15, 2027.
entries.verification: The opened SEGA first-party article on Xbox Wire supports the consent, archival-source, no-AI, story-span, release-date, and platform claims.
entries.timeNote: Published at 10:01 AM Beijing time on September 24, before the 10:10 AM cutoff.

entries.headline: Super Danganronpa 2×2 Reveals Sakutaro Higashi, Voiced by Natsuki Hanae
entries.summary: Spike Chunsoft revealed Sakutaro Higashi, a new character in Super Danganronpa 2×2’s Kyoki Mode, voiced by Natsuki Hanae. His Ultimate talent remains undisclosed. The game is scheduled for January 14, 2027, on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer reports both relay the official announcement and agree on the character, voice actor, mode, date, and platforms.
entries.timeNote: The later opened report was published at 9:51 AM Beijing time on September 24; the other was published at 9:07 AM, both before cutoff.

entries.headline: WWE “Vice City” trademark application: WWE Abandons Its “Vice City” Trademark Application; Reason Undisclosed
entries.summary: IGN reported from trademark records that WWE filed for the “Vice City” mark on August 8 and that the application was deemed dead on September 21. The reason was not confirmed; speculation involving Lola Vice or Rockstar Games is omitted.
entries.verification: The immutable packet contains only the opened IGN report. Filing and dead-status dates follow its cited trademark record, while the reason remains unknown.
entries.timeNote: Published at 7:33 PM Beijing time on September 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ARC Raiders’ Largest Update Yet, Frozen Trail, Arrives October 8
entries.summary: Nexon announced Frozen Trail for ARC Raiders on October 8 and described it as the game’s largest update since launch. It adds the Pendra Pass map, the fallen giant ARC Emperor, enemies including Bully, Stalker, and Hydra, plus the Grappling Hook, Tether Launcher, and Young Grenade.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Nexon’s announcement; the date and named map, enemies, and equipment all come from that evidence.
entries.timeNote: Published at 8:15 AM Beijing time on September 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Rakugaki Kingdom 2 Developer Says He Is Making “Something Rakugaki Kingdom-Like”
entries.summary: Black Belt Games head and former Rakugaki Kingdom 2 designer Yuichi Tanzawa said on the game’s 22nd anniversary that he is making “something Rakugaki Kingdom-like.” No project title, publisher, platforms, or schedule were disclosed, so this is not treated as a formal sequel announcement.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays Tanzawa’s statement; the packet provides no formal project identity, publishing entity, platform, or timing.
entries.timeNote: Published at 5:03 PM Beijing time on September 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: 2D action game AVELUNE announced with a customizable support robot
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that solo developer Skyho announced the 2D action game AVELUNE on September 23 for PC via Steam. Players explore the ruined kingdom of Avel and a giant tower that fell from the sky, configuring skills and a support robot for combat and exploration.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the announcement, developer, PC Steam platform, and core gameplay details; its descriptions are not upgraded into first-party confirmation.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON page was published at 12:19 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: JSAUX announces two display-equipped replacement faceplates for Steam Machine
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that JSAUX GAMING announced the E-Ink Faceplate for $99.99 and the Pixel Matrix Faceplate for $89.99, both planned to begin shipping in early October. The panels can show information such as the clock, weather, or device status.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report is the source for the product names, prices, and shipping window; no additional compatibility or sales-region claims are inferred.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON page was published at 17:47 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X launches its Fall 2026 major free update
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that Astrolabe Games and 91Act released the Fall 2026 major free content update for BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X. It adds elite enemies Nine the Phantom and The Lost Gearhulk plus the stage Remains; the Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch versions will receive the update later.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays the update information from publisher Astrolabe Games and developer 91Act, including the later timing for the Switch 2 and Switch versions.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu page was published at 10:00 Beijing time on September 24, before the 10:10 cutoff.

entries.headline: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies VR announced for Quest and Meta VR Glasses
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that AMATA Games announced Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies VR under license from Capcom. It is planned for 2027 on Quest and Meta VR Glasses and will support Simplified Chinese among its languages.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays AMATA Games' announcement, including the licensing relationship, target platforms, 2027 release window, and language support.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu page was published at 08:26 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Tetris Effect: Mixed Realities announced for Quest 3 and Meta VR Glasses
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that publisher Enhance and developers Monstars and Resonair announced Tetris Effect: Mixed Realities for release in 2027 on Quest 3 and Meta VR Glasses. The mixed-reality design changes the player's surrounding space alongside the game's scenes.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Enhance's announcement; the announcing parties, platforms, and 2027 release window come from that report.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu page was published at 08:53 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Discord relaunches age assurance using account signals before extra verification
entries.summary: Game Developer reports that Discord is relaunching its age-verification policy eight months after its first rollout. The system first uses account-level signals such as account age and payment methods to estimate whether a user is an adult or teen; Discord CTO Stanislav Vishnevskiy says more than 90% of existing users will not need additional verification, with credit card, app-store, and AgeKey methods among the new options.
entries.verification: The opened Game Developer report explicitly attributes the policy mechanics and the 'more than 90%' statement to Discord CTO and co-founder Stanislav Vishnevskiy.
entries.timeNote: The Game Developer page was published at 02:30 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件: The Convenience Store launches on Nintendo Switch 2 with new ending content
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Chilla's Art horror game The Convenience Store began distribution on September 24 and adds new ending content.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports only the Switch 2 launch and the addition of new ending content; promotional pricing is not used as the headline focus.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer RSS/page time converts to 23:00 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window; the report's 'today' refers to September 24 in Japan.

entries.headline: SCP Idle: SECURE. CONTAIN. PROGRESS. is set for an October 29 Steam release
